hints: Once a reading has a larger reading after it, can it ever be the answer for any later window?
No - every window containing it from then on also contains the larger one. So it can be discarded the moment the larger reading arrives.
Keep the readings that are still candidates in a deque, and they will always be in decreasing order: each new reading evicts every smaller one from the back.
The front of the deque is the window's maximum; when it falls out of the window by age, remove it from the front.
